Control characters, 0, unassigned bytes and values past Unicode type nothing; auto-repeat of a held digit adds nothing, and switching windows drops a half-typed code. Word counts only keypad digits; egui reports keypad and top-row digits alike, so top-row digits with Alt alone compose codes too. An Alt code never opens KeyTips.
